svg.title: Linux checkout: Git-native options and warm Git-snapshot
svg.desc: One production build, n=1, on hosted-large agents with mirrors off. Displayed waterfall durations include agent startup, not just cloning. Full clone with agent defaults: 252 seconds. Blobless clone with eight checkout workers: 259 seconds. Treeless clone with eight checkout workers: 214 seconds. Shallow clone, depth one, with eight checkout workers: 238 seconds. Git-snapshot with eight checkout workers: 30 seconds, the span of a two-job parallel group with warm snapshot and patch hits, not a sum or an individual job measurement. Snapshot seeding is not shown. Shallow loses history; treeless makes path history slow. Bars share a linear scale starting at zero, two pixels per second. Source: Git Snapshot Demo Linux build 5, git-snapshot-demo branch, commit 71f3a3d.
